event_var.var_meaning: overall survival status; inferred from the paper and censoring pattern as 1 = death/event, 0 = alive/censored at last follow-up, NA = missing

notes: GSM sample metadata explicitly contain 'survival time' and 'survival'.
The paper reports Kaplan-Meier overall survival and gives median overall survival in months, supporting 'survival time' as an overall survival time variable measured in months.
The coding of 'survival' is not explicitly defined in GEO; 1 = death and 0 = censored/alive is inferred because multiple long follow-up samples have value 0, consistent with censored survivors.
One GSM record have missing OS annotations ('survival time: NA' and 'survival: NA').

The paper also analyzes distant brain failure-free survival, local failure, and neurologic death, but no corresponding per-sample GSM variables for those endpoints were provided in the supplied metadata.
